Account overview: mid-market product analytics vendor building in-app insights and AI assistant for product managers. Primary goal is to reduce time-to-insight for customers and add a conversational layer to dashboards.

Timeline / recent activity:
- 2025-11-12: inbound signup, quick API trial on hosted.
- 2025-12-05: discovery call (Maya + Diego) — product goals, high-level security + residency needs.

POC details / metrics observed:
- Workloads: document search + short chat assistant + nightly embedding index updates.
- Target latency: 200-400ms p50 for chat, p95 < 800ms for search reranking.
- Throughput: ~30 qps peak for embeddings ingestion window, steady 8-12 qps for chat in-app.
- Initial hosted run: token cost higher than target; observed opportunity to drop unit cost with batching + caching + lower-cost model variants for fallback.
- Model preferences: prefer open-models for cost (Llama-2 family/LLM-compat), but want Redwood-verified latency profiles.

Security / deployment notes:
- Must support VPC peering and SAML SSO. SOC2 compliance required for contract. KMS integration needed for key separation. Data residency: seed customers in EU require logs retained in eu-region.

Cost optimization workshop agenda (requested):
- 1) Workload profiling: token distribution, typical prompt prefixes, KV cache hit rates.
- 2) Batching strategies: per-route batching windows vs latency SLOs; expected throughput gains.
- 3) KV/prefix caching: strategies to cache frequent prompts and multi-tenant cache partitions.
- 4) Quantization & model variant recommendation: 4-bit/8-bit tradeoffs, latency vs quality thresholds.
- 5) Unit economics: cost/token and cost/session targets for tiered pricing; break-even on Dedicated vs Hosted.
- 6) Rollout plan: canary on Hosted -> Dedicated reserved pools -> auto-fallback to hosted during load.

- "If we can get ~40% unit cost reduction without noticeable quality drop, Dedicated is an easy yes." — Head of Platform (Jonas Miller)
- "SSO + audit logging non-negotiable for sales contracts in EU." — Legal lead (Ana R.).

- Internal procurement requires TCO comparison doc (hosted vs 1yr dedicated commit + optimize savings).
- SRE wants exact network architecture for VPC peering and egress path (ask infra team for diagram).

- Deliver updated POC report with Dedicated pricing scenarios and recommended quantization profile by 2026-03-18.
